small.fitTitle: Make the investment fit the business.
small.fitIntro: The strongest fit is an established B2B company with a defined buyer, a credible offer and someone ready to handle sales meetings. Customer value and delivery capacity need to support ongoing prospecting.

small.fitExtra: Before committing, consider the gross profit a new customer can contribute, the time it takes to close and your ability to serve new accounts. We scope the work around those realities. A small team still needs to approve the campaign and follow through after the meeting.
faqs: What do your small business B2B lead generation services include?

The agreed scope can cover target-account preparation, prospect research, human cold calling, follow-up, qualification, appointment setting, handoff notes and reporting. We confirm the responsibilities, data requirements and calling effort in the proposal.
Can you work with a business that has no SDR team?

Yes. Your founder or salesperson can handle sales meetings while CallTeam manages the agreed prospecting work. You still need an established offer, clear approvals and someone able to follow up on opportunities.
Do we need to provide a prospect list?
We can work from suitable existing contacts or include new list development in the proposal. Fresh data, research and validation affect the scope and price.
How much does the service cost?

Managed programs start at US$4,000 per month for a campaign-ready company. Additional data, research, markets and campaign requirements affect the final quote. Most programs begin with an initial three-month engagement.
Is this different from outsourced SDR services?

This page focuses on the practical needs of a small B2B business. Outsourced SDR services describe the wider managed sales development function. The actual responsibilities are agreed for your campaign.
Do you guarantee a number of meetings?
No. Meeting volume depends on the market, offer, account access and qualification standard. We agree how meetings are qualified and report what the outreach produces.

professional.headline: Reach the companies that have a reason to talk.
professional.intro: CallTeam provides B2B lead generation and appointment setting for professional services firms. We research suitable companies, call relevant buyers and qualify the work they want to discuss before introducing them to your partner, specialist or salesperson.
professional.heroLabel: Start with the work you want to win.
heroRows: A problem, an owner and a useful first discussion.
A service need and a credible evaluation path.
Work your firm can deliver and a buyer who owns it.
professional.sectionTitle: What kind of engagement do you want to win?
professional.sectionIntro: Consulting, project delivery and outsourced business services need different conversations. We build the campaign around a specific service line and the clients it can genuinely help. These examples illustrate how the scope changes.

cards.label: A defined project
cards.title: Find a business problem worth scoping.
cards.text: For an advisory, implementation or delivery project, the first conversation should establish the work and who owns it.
cards.action: Research suitable accounts, ask about the current approach and qualify the objective, timing and participants for a scoping discussion.

cards.label: An ongoing engagement
cards.title: Understand why a firm would review its options.
cards.text: A retainer or managed service needs a reason to consider outside help, including how existing arrangements are working.
cards.action: Clarify the service need, internal resources, current provider, evaluation process and what the buyer wants from a first meeting.

cards.label: Specialist outsourced support
cards.title: Check the work and delivery fit.
cards.text: A company may need extra expertise or help with a defined workload. The caller needs to understand the boundaries of your service.
cards.action: Establish the assignment, responsible owner, delivery requirements and information your specialist needs to assess a useful next step.

professional.fitTitle: Scope the campaign around the engagement you sell.
professional.fitIntro: A campaign needs a defined service line, a reachable business audience, relevant proof and experts available for the next conversation. We also need to understand the value and delivery effort of the work you hope to win.
professional.fitBody: Managed outbound calling and appointment-setting programs start at US$4,000 per month for a campaign-ready firm. Research depth, new prospect data, buyer seniority, markets and wider campaign requirements affect the final scope. Most programs begin with an initial three-month engagement.
professional.fitExtra: Your proposal should make the audience, responsibilities, qualification standard and reporting clear. Reviews connect buyer responses with your team’s assessment of the meetings, so targeting and messaging can improve as the campaign runs.
faqs: What is professional services lead generation?

It is the work of identifying suitable business clients, reaching the relevant people and establishing whether there is a useful service discussion to have. CallTeam connects prospect research, human calling, follow-up, qualification and appointment setting around that goal.
Can CallTeam generate leads for consulting firms?

CallTeam can scope outbound for a consulting firm with a defined service, suitable client profile and credible proof. We agree the assignments to pursue and the questions a caller can handle before a consultant joins the conversation.
How do you qualify a professional services appointment?

We agree the standard before launch. It can include company fit, a responsible buyer, a relevant assignment or business need, interest, timing, delivery requirements and a clear purpose for the next discussion. Unknowns remain visible in the handoff.
Can you work alongside our existing referral business?
Yes. Outbound can create conversations with accounts outside your current network. We agree account ownership and exclusions so the campaign respects active clients, partners and opportunities.
How much does professional services lead generation cost?

Managed programs start at US$4,000 per month for a campaign-ready firm. Fresh data, research depth, additional markets and other requirements affect the quote. Most programs begin with an initial three-month engagement.
Will callers give advice or promise project outcomes?

Callers use approved service descriptions and evidence. Specialist advice, scope decisions and delivery commitments belong to your firm. Questions requiring an expert are recorded and passed to the appropriate person.
